sections.content_markdown: We know, properties, characteristics and changes of substances are the topics discussed in chemistry. The elements in nature are constantly changing. Transformation to a different state is called a physical change while changing into a new element with new properties is called a chemical change. These changes occur due to certain physical and chemical reactions. This chapter will discuss elaborately on kinds of reactions, rates of reactions etc.
